text.en:
Adjustment of Dividend Rate. Pursuant to Section 5 of RA No.
7656, the percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the DBP to the
National Government for CY 2021 is adjusted from fifty percent (50%) of its annual net
earnings to 0%.

Coverage. The adjusted dividend rate set forth in Section 1 of this
Order is applicable only to the DBP for CY 2021.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 9th
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Two.
day of December
By the President:
LUCAS P. BERSAMIN
/Exécutive Secretary
